name: Quant Foundry
short_description: An adversarial backtesting lab: walk-forward selection, a sealed holdout, explicit costs and published rejections, on synthetic markets.
capabilities: Deterministic synthetic market generator with validation and content hashes
Event-driven simulator: next-open fills, fees, slippage, position limits, reconciled accounting
Walk-forward parameter selection with a sealed, evaluate-once holdout and a cross-run holdout audit
Parameter sensitivity, benchmarks and explicit accept/reject verdicts with reasons
GitHub-native run ledger: issue intake, idempotent admission, state branch, reconciler
Outcome Verification Loop and Memory Curation Workflow running in GitHub Actions
Static, embeddable research report with an in-browser cost sensitivity estimate
data_limitations: All market data is synthetic; results do not describe any real exchange or asset
Mon-Fri calendar without holidays, corporate actions or market impact beyond fixed slippage
Long only, three strategy families, small parameter grids
The site shows a snapshot of the state branch, not live data
